tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App and page ground; also the Outline button and select fill. `foreground` reads on it at 19.8:1 (light) / 18:1 (dark).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text on `background`, `card`, `accent` and `secondary`. Also the Total line in stacked charts.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card surface (`Card`, toast, sticky table header). Slightly raised from `background` in dark only.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Reserved for floating surfaces. Not used by any screen yet.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one solid action per form or card (Default button), checked Switch track, Progress fill. Neutral ink, not a hue.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` (17.2:1 light, 14.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-light
tokens.usage: Defined by the source theme; not used by any screen yet.

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.usage: Defined by the source theme; not used by any screen yet.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Progress track, loading skeletons (`pf-sk`, `LoadingBlock`), Secondary badge and button fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: inset summary boxes (`bg-muted/40`), table row hover (`bg-muted/50`), read-only inputs, Tabs list.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, field labels, hints, table heads, chart axes, inactive nav. 4.7:1 on `background`/`card`, 4.5:1 on `muted` in light; 5.8:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill for Ghost and Outline buttons and for clickable option tiles.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Money owed, negative amounts, errors, the Delete button, the minimum-balance line and the Debt series in charts. As text on `card`: 4.8:1 light, 6.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: destructive-light
tokens.usage: Defined for tinted error surfaces; not used by any screen yet.

tokens.name: destructive-dark
tokens.usage: Defined for text on `destructive-light`; not used by any screen yet.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: cards, table rows, inset rows, sidebar edge. Applied globally (`* { border-color }`), so a bare `border` class is enough.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Border of inputs and selects; unchecked Switch track; `input/30` is the field fill in dark.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring (`ring-ring/50`, 2 to 3px) and the selected-card border. At full strength it is 2.6:1 on `background` in light and 4:1 in dark; at 50% it is fainter still. Kept exact from the source theme.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Cash series (light blue). 1.8:1 on a light `card`, so never use it for text or thin marks alone; pair with the legend.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Seventh colour in the per-account palette.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Net worth and Spendable series: the lead line, drawn bold. First colour of every palette. 5.3:1 on light `card`, 3.4:1 on dark.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Defined by the source theme; not used by a chart. In dark it is the active sidebar hue (`sidenav-primary`).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fourth/fifth colour in categorical palettes. 2:1 on a dark `card`: it nearly disappears there, so keep it for filled areas, not lines.

tokens.name: chart-primary
tokens.usage: Defined by the source theme; not used by a chart.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: The Unallocated layer in the accounts and buckets chart.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Horizontal gridlines in `LineChart` and `StackedChart`. The zero line uses `muted-foreground` instead.

tokens.name: sidenav
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground.

tokens.name: sidenav-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidenav`.

tokens.name: sidenav-primary
tokens.usage: Defined by the source theme; not used by the sidebar yet.

tokens.name: sidenav-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidenav-primary`.

tokens.name: sidenav-accent
tokens.usage: Fill of the current page in the sidebar, and its hover fill.

tokens.name: sidenav-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the current page in the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidenav-border
tokens.usage: Defined by the source theme; the sidebar edge uses `border`.

tokens.name: sidenav-ring
tokens.usage: Defined by the source theme; not used yet.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Defined by the source theme for text selection; inputs select with `primary` instead.

tokens.name: selection-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `selection`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive money and good states as large figures (stat values, payoff dates), the Retirement series, paid-off ticks. As text on a light `card` it is 3.0:1: use it at `text-lg` semibold or larger, or use a Success badge for small text.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `success` fill. 2.9:1 in light, 5.9:1 in dark; the solid Success button is not used by any screen.

tokens.name: success-light
tokens.usage: Success badge fill.

tokens.name: success-dark
tokens.usage: Success badge text on `success-light` (9:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: The Investments series and warning figures. 3.4:1 as text on a light `card`: large text only; use a Warning badge for small text.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `warning` fill (3.3:1 light, 5.3:1 dark); the solid Warning button is not used by any screen.

tokens.name: warning-light
tokens.usage: Warning badge fill ("Was planned", "bill").

tokens.name: warning-dark
tokens.usage: Warning badge text on `warning-light` (9.5:1 light, 7:1 dark).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Categorical chart colour; informational accents. 4.8:1 as text on a light `card`.

tokens.name: info-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `info` fill.

tokens.name: info-light
tokens.usage: Info badge fill ("Planned", "Gets the extra payment", "expense").

tokens.name: info-dark
tokens.usage: Info badge text on `info-light` (9.3:1 light, 6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: slider-track
tokens.usage: Defined by the source theme; no slider exists yet.

tokens.name: scrollbar-thumb
tokens.usage: Defined by the source theme (marked "shortfix" there); scrollbars are native.

tokens.name: scrollbar-track
tokens.usage: Defined by the source theme; scrollbars are native.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Defined by the source theme; no screen uses it. Use `muted` for inset fills.

tokens.name: surface-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `surface`.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, in `PageHeader` (`text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight`).

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Name of an item inside a card: option tiles, list rows (`text-sm font-semibold`).

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: The number in a `Stat` card. Always `tabular-nums`.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: A balance or key number inside a card or row (`text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums`).

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a stat value (`text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground`).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rent, utilities and your other bills come first.
styles.usage: Default text: descriptions, table cells, buttons, inputs (`text-sm`).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, button labels, table heads, current nav item (`text-sm font-medium`).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines, hints, chart legends, in-card notes (`text-xs`, usually `text-muted-foreground`).

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: Label above a form control, set by `Field` (`text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground`).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Sidebar footnote and chart axis labels (11px in the SVG). Nothing smaller except small badges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest stack: a figure and its caption (`gap-1`). Base unit of the scale.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Label to control inside `Field`; icon to text in small buttons and legends (`gap-1.5`).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default inline gap: buttons in a row, badge to text, legend to plot (`gap-2`).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between fields in a form; padding of inset boxes and list rows (`gap-3`, `p-3`, `px-3`).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between stat cards and between blocks inside a card; padding of an item card (`gap-4`, `p-4`). Page padding when narrow.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections and columns (`gap-6`); horizontal and vertical padding of a `Card`. Page padding at medium width.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding when wide (`@3xl:p-8`).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Padding of `EmptyState` (`p-10`).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Base radius the others are derived from. Equals `rounded-lg`.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: `calc(radius - 4px)`. Legend squares in stacked charts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: `calc(radius - 2px)`. Controls: buttons, inputs, selects, badges, nav items, skeletons, table wrapper.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Things inside a card: item cards, option tiles, inset boxes, the toast.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: `calc(radius + 4px)`. Top-level `Card` and `EmptyState`.

shadow.note: Shadows are flat on purpose: blurred shadows on every card were the largest paint cost in the desktop webview.

tokens.name: shadow-2xs
tokens.usage: Not used directly.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: `Card` and the active tab.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The only blurred shadow: the toast and the Switch thumb, which float above the page.

size.note: Phone-only sizes from the mobile plan (mobile.md). The desktop app does not use them.

tokens.name: touch-target-ios
tokens.usage: Smallest tap area on iPhone (Apple HIG, in points). Pad the hit area of smaller controls up to this.

tokens.name: touch-target-android
tokens.usage: Smallest tap area on Android (Material, in dp).

tokens.name: mobile-gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of every phone screen and full-width section.

tokens.name: mobile-tab-bar
tokens.usage: Height of the bottom tab bar, before the home-indicator or navigation-bar inset is added.

tokens.name: mobile-top-bar
tokens.usage: Height of the collapsed top bar on both platforms.

tokens.name: mobile-fab
tokens.usage: Size of the Android floating action button (Material standard FAB).

tokens.name: mobile-row
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a tappable list row (a debt, an account, a payment).
